events.description: 51. ORDER that Defendants Motion to Dismiss is GRANTED IN PART and DENIED IN PART. All claims asserted against the Individual Defendants (Marvin Cornelison, Nina Crawford, Tommy Davis, Ron McKelvy, and Tonya Moore) in their individual capacities are DISMISSED. Plaintiffs' First Amendment freedom of association claim against all Defendants for the March 8th Ballot Inclusion is also DISMISSED. The only remaining claims are the Plaintiffs' First Amendment freedom of association for the Boards April 2nd vote and the freedom of speech claim against the Board of Elections and the Individual Defendants in their official capacities, in addition to the Plaintiffs petition for an injunction to prevent future violation of their First Amendment claims as alleged. Signed by Judge William M. Ray, II on 2/25/2025. (cnw) (Entered: 02/25/2026)
